offers.summary: 10% instant discount on HDFC Bank credit and debit cards, up to ₹1,000
offers.termsText: Demo offer. 10% instant discount, up to ₹1,000, on the value of eligible items when the amount payable is paid with an HDFC Bank credit or debit card. Applies when eligible items total ₹2,500 or more after any coupon. Not applicable when credits or a gift card cover the full amount. One discount per order. Valid until 31 Dec 2027.
